key: CAL: Enough, Blake.
en: CAL: Enough, Blake.
ja: キャル: もういい、ブレイク。

key: It's over, and you've lost.
en: It's over, and you've lost.
ja: 終わりだ、お前の負けだ。

key: BLAKE: Hah.
en: BLAKE: Hah.
ja: ブレイク: ハッ。

key: Well, if little Callie-Wallie isn't all grown up.
en: Well, if little Callie-Wallie isn't all grown up.
ja: おやおや、ちっちゃいキャリー・ウォリーもすっかり大人になっちゃって。

key: He finally learned to beat trainers with a team full of type advantages!
en: He finally learned to beat trainers with a team full of type advantages!
ja: タイプ有利だらけのパーティでトレーナーを倒す方法をようやく覚えたのか!

key: It only took you, like, what? Ten years?
en: It only took you, like, what? Ten years?
ja: それに何年かかったんだよ、え? 10年?

key: More?
en: More?
ja: もっとか?

key: CAL: Say what you will.
en: CAL: Say what you will.
ja: キャル: 好きなだけ言え。

key: It's time for you to let this all go, and go home.
en: It's time for you to let this all go, and go home.
ja: もうこの辺で全部手放して、家に帰る時間だ。

key: BLAKE: What're you gonna do if I don't, tell Daddy?
en: BLAKE: What're you gonna do if I don't, tell Daddy?
ja: ブレイク: そうしなかったらどうすんの、パパにチクる?

key: You gonna say he should spank me?
en: You gonna say he should spank me?
ja: 俺をお仕置きしろって言うつもり?

key: The old man kicked it; I don't need you telling me what to do in his stead unless you wanna follow through to his end too.
en: The old man kicked it; I don't need you telling me what to do in his stead unless you wanna follow through to his end too.
ja: 親父はくたばったんだ。あんたが親父の代わりに指図してくるつもりなら、同じ末路をたどりたいってことでいいんだよな。

key: CAL: I'm not interested in your commentary.
en: CAL: I'm not interested in your commentary.
ja: キャル: お前の解説には興味ない。

key: Whine all you want.
en: Whine all you want.
ja: 好きなだけ愚痴ればいい。

key: I'll be outside.
en: I'll be outside.
ja: 俺は外にいる。

key: There's only one exit.
en: There's only one exit.
ja: 出口は一つしかない。

key: As soon as you're done pitching your fit, I'm taking you back.
en: As soon as you're done pitching your fit, I'm taking you back.
ja: 駄々をこね終わったら、連れ戻すからな。

key: By force or otherwise.
en: By force or otherwise.
ja: 力ずくでも、そうでなくても。

key: BLAKE: Awwwwh, I'm so scawed!
en: BLAKE: Awwwwh, I'm so scawed!
ja: ブレイク: うわぁ~ん、こわ~い!

key: Shut the fuck up.
en: Shut the fuck up.
ja: うるせえよ。

key: You don't even know what force is, bro!
en: You don't even know what force is, bro!
ja: 力ってものがどういうことか、あんたわかってすらいないだろ!

key: People like you are all talk and no action.
en: People like you are all talk and no action.
ja: あんたみたいな奴は口だけで何もしない。

key: BLAKE: If you're so set on doing something, come back here and do it!
en: BLAKE: If you're so set on doing something, come back here and do it!
ja: ブレイク: 何かする気があるなら、ここに戻ってきてやってみろよ!

key: Don't just turn your backside and ignore me.
en: Don't just turn your backside and ignore me.
ja: 尻向けて無視すんな。

key: You really are just like him.
en: You really are just like him.
ja: 本当に親父そっくりだな。

key: BLAKE: And what do YOU want?
en: BLAKE: And what do YOU want?
ja: ブレイク: で、あんたは何が欲しいわけ?

key: BLAKE: ...Hah, is that what I think it is?
en: BLAKE: ...Hah, is that what I think it is?
ja: ブレイク: …ハッ、これって俺が思ってるアレか?

key: An extra life, huh.
en: An extra life, huh.
ja: エクストラライフか。

key: Don't mind if I do.
en: Don't mind if I do.
ja: 遠慮なくいただくぜ。

key: BLAKE: Ain't that convenient.
en: BLAKE: Ain't that convenient.
ja: ブレイク: 都合がいいこと。

key: His team is still worn out from the battle, too.
en: His team is still worn out from the battle, too.
ja: しかもあいつのパーティはまだバトルで消耗したままだ。

key: I can rip him to shreds easily now.
en: I can rip him to shreds easily now.
ja: 今なら簡単にズタボロにできる。

key: You gonna try and get in my way?
en: You gonna try and get in my way?
ja: 邪魔するつもりか?

key: BLAKE: Then I just have to take you out first!
en: BLAKE: Then I just have to take you out first!
ja: ブレイク: だったら先にあんたを片付けるだけだ!

key: BLAKE: That's real nice of you.
en: BLAKE: That's real nice of you.
ja: ブレイク: そりゃご丁寧にどうも。

key: Unfortunately, I don't trust you as far as I can roll you.
en: Unfortunately, I don't trust you as far as I can roll you.
ja: 残念ながら、あんたを転がせる距離くらいしか信用してねえけど。

key: Tch. Then what was the point?
en: Tch. Then what was the point?
ja: ちっ。じゃあ　何のためだったんだよ

key: BLAKE: ...
en: BLAKE: ...
ja: ブレイク: …

key: So, where's that 'assistance' she promised?
en: So, where's that 'assistance' she promised?
ja: で、あの女が約束してた『援護』とやらはどこだよ?

key: You know?
en: You know?
ja: なあ?

key: I may be a jerk sometimes, but I'm not completely stupid.
en: I may be a jerk sometimes, but I'm not completely stupid.
ja: 俺は時々クズだけど、完全なバカってわけじゃない。

key: Or that's what I'd say, if I hadn't actually believed that that woman would try and help.
en: Or that's what I'd say, if I hadn't actually believed that that woman would try and help.
ja: って言いたいところだけど、あの女が本当に助けてくれると信じてた時点で、それも怪しいもんだな。

key: "Wait in the crystal branches," she said.
en: "Wait in the crystal branches," she said.
ja: 『結晶の支線で待て』って、あいつ言ってた。

key: "Just buy more time," she said.
en: "Just buy more time," she said.
ja: 『とにかく時間を稼げ』って、あいつ言ってた。

key: Yeah, right.
en: Yeah, right.
ja: ああ、そうかよ。

key: I'm not surprised, just annoyed.
en: I'm not surprised, just annoyed.
ja: 驚きゃしないけど、ムカつくのは事実だ。

key: I don't know what she's doing, spending so much time tinkering on those machines...
en: I don't know what she's doing, spending so much time tinkering on those machines...
ja: あの機械をいじくり回してあいつが何やってるのか知らねえけど…

key: But one thing is for sure:
en: But one thing is for sure:
ja: でも一つ確かなことがある:

key: She wants to win,
en: She wants to win,
ja: あいつは勝ちたがってる、

key: But she intends to win alone.
en: But she intends to win alone.
ja: だが一人で勝つつもりだ。

key: Everyone else is just noob trash to be KO'd.
en: Everyone else is just noob trash to be KO'd.
ja: 他の奴らはただの雑魚、倒されるだけの駒だ。

key: I've known this isn't going to work for a while-- since you showed up to Ametrine, in fact.
en: I've known this isn't going to work for a while-- since you showed up to Ametrine, in fact.
ja: こんなのうまくいかねえって、しばらく前からわかってた――実際、あんたがアメトリンに現れてからずっとな。

key: Sunken cost really be like that though.
en: Sunken cost really be like that though.
ja: サンクコストってやつは本当にそういうもんだよな。

key: Leave too early, and they'll pull you back and hold you under.
en: Leave too early, and they'll pull you back and hold you under.
ja: 早く抜けようとすると、引きずり戻されて沈められる。

key: I know you probably hate me too or whatever, and that's fine.
en: I know you probably hate me too or whatever, and that's fine.
ja: あんたも俺のこと嫌いだろうけど、まあそれでいい。

key: But I'm counting on you to end this before they end me.
en: But I'm counting on you to end this before they end me.
ja: でも、あいつらに俺が終わらされる前に、あんたがこれを終わらせてくれるのを頼りにしてるぜ。

key: Take your time if you want, fam.
en: Take your time if you want, fam.
ja: 急がなくていいぜ、相棒。

key: I'll let "Daddy" drag me home for now.
en: I'll let "Daddy" drag me home for now.
ja: とりあえず『パパ』に家まで引きずってってもらうよ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
